description: This file defines the ListPartSettingsDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and editing of ListPart settings within OrchardCore CMS. It includes methods for rendering the settings UI and updating settings based on user input.

classes.name: ListPartSettingsDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver class for managing the settings UI of ListPart in OrchardCore, including editing and updating settings.

methods.name: ListPartSettingsDisplayDriver
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for the display driver.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Renders the settings editing UI for ListPart, populating the view model with current settings and available content types.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes updates to ListPart settings submitted by the user, validates input, updates settings, and initializes content order if needed.
